title: 'What we need is here'
content: Writer and farmer Wendell Berry (born 1934) has advocated finding inspiration close to home. "What we need is here," he said. "I am not bound for any public place, but for ground of my own."Artist Andrew Wyeth, above, created most of his work within walking distance of his home in Pennsylvania or in his tiny realm in Maine. He said, “Most artists look for something fresh to paint; frankly I find that quite boring. For me it is much more exciting to find fresh meaning in something familiar.”----
